notes.title: Endgame update details
notes.content:
1. Map quality update: All maps have been updated from a dark and gloomy atmosphere to a bright and clear background.

2. Game optimization: The game has been improved to be smoother.

3. Dungeon update: When dying in a dungeon, a “Continue” function has been added.

4. Equipment update: The more enhanced the equipment, the more splendid it becomes.

(The actual game quality is much better than the trailer video)

notes.title: Endgame price adjustment and costume update
notes.content:
Thank you for visiting our website.

The price of Endgame, the world's most difficult control game, has been reduced from $35 to $8.

We ask for your interest. 

-Costume patch contents-

Costume 1 is a free product.

Costume 2 is a $1 product.

·How to use
After purchasing this package, you can wear it through the character selection window or the in-game costume shop.
